blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine men’s baseball team opens its Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 campaign on Monday against Palestine in Group A at Toyohashi Municipal Baseball Stadium. First pitch is at 11 a.m. Manila time as the Filipino batters hope to produce a winning start in their bid to qualify for the Super Round. But the odds are stacked against the Philippines as it is grouped alongside powerhouse Japan and China. After Palestine, the Philippines faces China on Tuesday before taking on Japan the following day. The top two teams in […]...
